segments.name: Corporate CLOs
segments.description: Invests primarily in mezzanine debt and equity tranches of corporate CLOs for attractive current yields and risk-adjusted total returns.
segments.evidence: The Company operates through a single operating and reporting segment with an objective to generate attractive current yields and risk-adjusted total returns for its shareholders by acquiring, investing in, and managing its targeted assets.

revenueModel.text: Earns net interest income from coupon interest and amortization on its CLO and RMBS securities holdings.
